minutes.headline: ZBA granted two special permits: relief from the one-year ADU wait on a farm, and a Sunset Lane rebuild with conditions.
minutes.summary: The Zoning Board of Appeals heard two special permit petitions and granted both. The board then discussed a proposal to change how application fees and abutter notification are handled, with a vote deferred to the next meeting because it was not posted. It also noted an alternate member's resignation and adjourned.

attendees.role: Building Commissioner (referred to, not clearly present)

public_comment.topic: A surveyor from the engineering firm that did the original work said the foundation location was staked to match the approved plan and would be monitored, and that the garage room is not shown as a bedroom on the plans.
Chair asked for further public comment in the room and on Zoom; no one else spoke.

votes.motion: Grant a special permit for relief from the one-year waiting period for occupancy of the accessory dwelling unit at 615 Townsen Street.
votes.outcome: passed (roll call of ayes heard; individual count not clear in captions)

votes.motion: Approve the special permit/dimensional variations at 12 Sunset Lane on conditions: comply with Board of Health requirements, submit a revised engineering plan, and locate the building exactly where it was before with the same variances as 2021.
votes.outcome: passed (roll call of ayes heard; individual count not clear in captions)

budget_items.what_was_said: The current filing fee has long been the same, with an extra per-abutter charge past a threshold, and does not cover advertising and postage. Counsel advised fees cannot be raised for revenue purposes.
figures_as_heard: $2 over and above for each person

budget_items.what_was_said: The Ledger charges per ad, run two weeks before a hearing; the proposal is that the applicant prepay advertising.
Members suggested asking counsel about a modest increase, possibly higher for commercial; the fee has not changed in about 26 years.
The secretary said the board's total budget is small and mostly payroll and postage.
Surrounding towns' fees were reviewed; the highest seen was for a final filing, and most are roughly in a range near the current fee.
A recent application with many abutters cost the town substantial postage and exceeded the base fee.

decisions.decision: Proposal agreed to be brought for a vote at the next meeting: keep the filing fee the same for commercial and residential, applicant prepays advertising online, and applicant supplies stamped envelopes for abutter notices. Not voted tonight because the item was not posted.
Secretary to raise with the town the idea of tablets to use the online portal instead of printed packets.
Members asked staff to go back to town counsel about a modest fee increase and to bring comparable-town fee information to the next meeting.
Board agreed to accept an alternate member's resignation and send a thank-you notice.

what_happened.line: The Zoning Board of Appeals granted a special permit for relief from the one-year waiting period for occupancy of an accessory dwelling unit on Townsen Street.
The board granted a special permit for dimensional variations at 12 Sunset Lane, on conditions: Board of Health compliance, a revised engineering plan, and the building placed where it stood before.
Members agreed to bring a proposal on application fees and abutter notification to a vote at the next meeting; it was not voted because the item was not posted.
Members asked staff to go back to town counsel about a modest fee increase and to bring comparable-town fee information to the next meeting.
The board agreed to accept an alternate member's resignation and send a thank-you notice.

why_it_matters: The fee proposal would shift advertising and mailing costs for abutter notices onto applicants, which touches what a homeowner pays to apply for a variance or special permit.
Counsel advised that fees cannot be raised for revenue purposes, so any increase has to be justified by the cost of the process, not by the town's budget needs.
watch_next: The fee and abutter-notification proposal returns for a vote at the next ZBA meeting, once it is posted.
Staff are to bring town counsel's view on a modest fee increase and comparable-town fee information to the next meeting.
